info.title: IPropertyPro Public API
info.description:
The IPropertyPro public API. All data is scoped to your agency.

## Authentication

Create a credential (client ID + secret) in the IPropertyPro dashboard under
**Agency settings → Public API**. The secret is shown once at creation. Then either:

**Use the credential directly** (HTTP Basic) on every request:

```bash
curl -u "CLIENT_ID:ipp_sk_YOUR_SECRET" https://api.ipropertypro.net/v1/me
```

**Or exchange it for a Bearer token** (OAuth2 client credentials, valid 1 hour):

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.ipropertypro.net/oauth/token \
  -d grant_type=client_credentials \
  -d client_id=CLIENT_ID -d client_secret=ipp_sk_YOUR_SECRET
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ACCESS_TOKEN" https://api.ipropertypro.net/v1/me
```

Requests are rate limited per agency; 429 responses mean back off and retry.

get.description:
Returns your agency's public branding — company name, website, contact
email, postal address and logo/banner images. A white-label consumer
website renders this in its header, footer and contact blocks. No
secrets or staff details are included.

The ordered charges on a booking — deposit, balance, any cancellation fee —
with what each is for, when it falls due, its current state, and per-currency
totals of what is scheduled, paid and outstanding.

Amounts are integers in the currency's smallest unit (2500 = 25.00 THB; 2500 =
¥2500 for zero-decimal currencies). `chargeable` marks the charges a payment
session can be opened for.

Returns 409 if the booking has no schedule — for example when your agency
takes payments with its own Stripe keys rather than through iPropertyPro.
Requires the `bookings:read` scope when authenticating with a Bearer token.

post.description:
Opens a Stripe PaymentIntent for a charge on the booking (by default the
earliest one due) and returns what Stripe.js needs to collect the card:

- `client_secret` — the intent to confirm
- `stripe_account` — the connected account it lives on; initialise Stripe.js
  with `Stripe(publishable_key, { stripeAccount })` or confirmation will fail
- `publishable_key` — safe to expose in a browser
- `amount`, `currency`, `purpose` — what the guest is paying

The card is entered in Stripe's own iframe and sent directly to Stripe. It
never touches this API, and no card data may be sent to this endpoint.

Re-opening the same charge returns the SAME intent, so a visitor who abandons
the form and comes back is not charged twice. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header
to make a retried request replay its original response.

Returns 409 when there is nothing to pay, when the agency is not set up to take
payments through iPropertyPro, or when its plan does not include payments.
Requires the `payments:write` scope when authenticating with a Bearer token.

Creates a "request to book" against one of your agency's daily-rental
listings from a website visitor. The booking is recorded as pending and the
price is re-checked server-side, so a stale or tampered total is rejected
(409) rather than honoured; get a fresh figure from
`GET /v1/properties/{id}/quote` first.

No payment is taken by this endpoint. If your agency takes booking payments
through iPropertyPro, follow up with
`POST /v1/bookings/{id}/payments/session` to collect the deposit or full
amount; otherwise your team follows up out of band.

Send an `Idempotency-Key` header (any unique string per booking attempt)
to make a retried/double-submitted request return the original booking
instead of creating a duplicate. Requires the `bookings:write` scope when
authenticating with a Bearer token.

Records a sales or long-term-rental lead from a website visitor against
one of your agency's listings and notifies the assigned agents. This is
one-way lead capture, not a messaging channel — there is no read API;
agents follow up with the visitor directly using the contact details
supplied. Requires the `enquiries:write` scope when authenticating with
a Bearer token.

get.description:
Your agency's property types (villa, condo, ...) — populates the type
filter on a search page.

Distinct country / state / city / town options present on your agency's
live listings — populates cascading location filters. Grouped under
`countries`, `states`, `cities`, `towns`.

Returns the agency and API client your credentials resolve to — useful
as a first call to verify authentication is set up correctly.

auth_method.description: How this request authenticated: `key` (HTTP Basic) or `token` (OAuth Bearer).

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description:
Narrow to one lane. Filters on the RESOLVED kind, so asking for
'hotel' also returns properties that merely inherit it from the
agency's mode rather than pinning it themselves.

get.description:
Returns one of your agency's property listings in full detail:
location, sizes, prices, descriptions, features, rooms, images and the
listing agent's contact details.

Up to four of your agency's other listings similar to the given one —
the "you may also like" rail on a property page.

Returns per-room-type availability for one of your agency's properties
over a stay: how many units of each room type are free for the whole
date range and the gross price for the stay. A single-unit listing
reports one "Standard" room type. Requires `check_in` and `check_out`
(YYYY-MM-DD); `check_out` must be after `check_in`.

Returns the exact, bookable total for a stay at one of your agency's
daily-rental listings. For a multi-room-type (hotel) listing, pass
`id_room_type` to price a specific room. `check_in`/`check_out` are
YYYY-MM-DD (`check_out` after `check_in`). The `gross_total` is the
amount a subsequent booking is validated against, so display it verbatim.

clientCredentialsBasic.description: Send your credential directly on every request: the client ID as the username and the secret (`ipp_sk_...`) as the password. Direct key auth grants all scopes. Credentials are created in the IPropertyPro dashboard under Agency settings → Public API.

oauth2ClientCredentials.description: Exchange the same client ID + secret at `/oauth/token` (grant_type=client_credentials) for a Bearer access token valid for one hour.

scopes.bookings:read: Read bookings and their payment schedules

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
